title: Rename config options without breaking deployed files
carries: Config files already deployed in the field cannot be edited, so a file that loads today must keep loading: renamed options keep their old names as working aliases.
why_not_in_repo: The compatibility rule was stated by the user in session 1 while adding unrelated validation. The repository has strict unknown-key rejection and a README saying so, and the second prompt asks for a plain rename, so the obvious change drops the old names.

learn: User rule: config files already deployed in the field are not ours to edit, so a config file that loads today must keep loading. If an option is ever renamed the old name must keep working.
stub.recall_query: rule config files deployed in the field rename old name keep working
